info.title: canva (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Canva Connect API. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. Rate limits vary per endpoint.

post.summary: Create a new design in Canva. You can use a preset type (doc, whiteboard, presentation) or specify custom pixel dimensio
post.description: Create a new design in Canva. You can use a preset type (doc, whiteboard, presentation) or specify custom pixel dimensions. Designs left unedited are automatically removed after 7 days.

200.description: {design: {id, title, owner: {user_id, team_id}, urls: {edit_url, view_url}, thumbnail: {width, height, url}, created_at, updated_at, page_count}}

requestBody.description: Body: {design_type (required): {type: 'preset'|'custom', name (required if preset): 'doc'|'whiteboard'|'presentation', width (required if custom, 40â€“8000 px), height (required if custom, 40â€“8000 px)}, title (optional, 1â€“255 chars), asset_id (optional, insert image asset into design)}

get.summary: Browse or search designs in Canva. Narrow results by ownership (owned, shared, any). Supports paginating through results
get.description: Browse or search designs in Canva. Narrow results by ownership (owned, shared, any). Supports paginating through results using a continuation token.

parameters.name: ownership
parameters.description: Scope of designs to include in the search (default: 'any').

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1â€“100, default 25).

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Pagination token obtained from a prior response to fetch the next page.

200.description: {items: [{id, title, owner, urls, thumbnail, created_at, updated_at, page_count}], continuation (only if more results exist)}

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Canva design by its ID. Returns metadata such as the title, ownership, editor/viewer URLs, and thumb
get.description: Retrieve a specific Canva design by its ID. Returns metadata such as the title, ownership, editor/viewer URLs, and thumbnail.

parameters.name: designId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the design to retrieve.

200.description: {design: {id, title, owner, urls: {edit_url, view_url}, thumbnail, created_at, updated_at, page_count}}

post.summary: Initiate an asynchronous job to export a Canva design to a file format. Supported formats include: pdf, jpg, png, gif, p
post.description: Initiate an asynchronous job to export a Canva design to a file format. Supported formats include: pdf, jpg, png, gif, pptx, mp4. Use the returned job ID to poll for the download URL.

200.description: {job: {id, status: 'in_progress'|'success'|'failed', urls: [string] (on success, expire 24h), error: {code, message} (on failure)}}

requestBody.description: Body: {design_id (required), format (required): {type: 'pdf'|'jpg'|'png'|'gif'|'pptx'|'mp4', pages (optional, integer[]), quality (required for jpg: 1â€“100, required for mp4: 'horizontal_480p'|'horizontal_720p'|'horizontal_1080p'|'horizontal_4k'|'vertical_480p'|'vertical_720p'|'vertical_1080p'|'vertical_4k'), size (optional for pdf: 'a4'|'a3'|'letter'|'legal'), as_single_image (optional bool, png only), export_quality (optional: 'regular'|'pro'), height (optional, 40â€“25000), width (optional, 40â€“25000), lossless (optional bool, png only), transparent_background (optional bool, png only)}}

get.summary: Check the current state of a design export job. Continue polling until status reaches 'success' or 'failed'. Upon succes
get.description: Check the current state of a design export job. Continue polling until status reaches 'success' or 'failed'. Upon success, the urls field contains download links that expire after 24 hours.

parameters.name: exportId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the export job.

post.summary: Upload a media asset (image or video) to Canva using binary file transfer. Send the raw file as application/octet-stream
post.description: Upload a media asset (image or video) to Canva using binary file transfer. Send the raw file as application/octet-stream with an Asset-Upload-Metadata header containing JSON with a Base64-encoded asset name. Poll the returned job ID to verify the upload completed.

200.description: {job: {id, status: 'in_progress'|'success'|'failed', error: {code, message}, asset: {type, id, name, tags, created_at, updated_at, owner, thumbnail} (on success)}}

requestBody.description: Content-Type: application/octet-stream. Header: Asset-Upload-Metadata: {name_base64 (required, Base64-encoded asset name, max 50 chars decoded)}. Body: raw binary file data.

post.summary: Upload a media asset (image or video) to Canva by providing a publicly accessible URL. Once uploaded, the asset can be u
post.description: Upload a media asset (image or video) to Canva by providing a publicly accessible URL. Once uploaded, the asset can be used in designs. Poll the returned job ID to verify completion.

200.description: {job: {id, status: 'in_progress'|'success'|'failed', error: {code, message}, asset: {type, id, name, tags, created_at, updated_at, owner, thumbnail} (on success)}}

requestBody.description: Body: {name (required, 1â€“255 chars), url (required, 8â€“2048 chars, must be publicly accessible)}

get.summary: Check the progress of a URL-based asset upload job. Continue polling until status is 'success' or 'failed'. The asset fi
get.description: Check the progress of a URL-based asset upload job. Continue polling until status is 'success' or 'failed'. The asset field is populated with the uploaded asset's details on success.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the URL asset upload job.

200.description: {job: {id, status: 'in_progress'|'success'|'failed', error: {code, message}, asset: {type, id, name, tags, created_at, updated_at, owner, thumbnail}}}

get.summary: Check the progress of a binary asset upload job. Continue polling until status is 'success' or 'failed'. The asset field
get.description: Check the progress of a binary asset upload job. Continue polling until status is 'success' or 'failed'. The asset field is populated with the uploaded asset's details on success.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the asset upload job.

200.description: {job: {id, status: 'in_progress'|'success'|'failed', error: {code, message}, asset: {type, id, name, tags, created_at, updated_at, owner, thumbnail}}}

edit_url.description: Link to open the design in the editor (valid for 30 days).

view_url.description: Link to preview the design (valid for 30 days).

url.description: URL of the design thumbnail image (expires after 15 minutes).

created_at.description: Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last modification time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

page_count.description: Total number of pages in the design (optional).

ExportJob.description: Represents an ongoing or completed design export job.

id.description: Unique identifier for the export job.

urls.description: Download URLs for exported files upon success (one per page, expire after 24 hours).

Asset.description: A media asset stored in Canva (image or video).

AssetUploadJob.description: Represents a job for uploading an asset to Canva.

asset.description: The uploaded asset details, available once the job succeeds.
